fantasy.name: Realms of Myth & Magic
fantasy.description: A vibrant world of abundant magic, diverse races, epic dungeons, and an ancient threat.
fantasy.tone_guidelines: Write epic, mythic prose focused on classic high fantasy heroism, political intrigue, and grand adventure.

sci_fi.name: Beyond the Outer Rim
sci_fi.description: An expansive galactic expanse of uncharted star systems, ancient alien ruins, interstellar trading hubs, and rogue spacefarers.
sci_fi.tone_guidelines: Write clinical, awe-inspiring prose focused on technological wonder, interstellar politics, and exploration.

cyberpunk.name: Neon Chrome & Mirrors
cyberpunk.description: A neon-soaked dystopian megacity ruled by ruthless megacorporations, cybernetic black markets, and rogue netrunners.
cyberpunk.tone_guidelines: Write gritty, cynical prose focused on neon-drenched urban decay, corporate oppression, and high-tech rebellion.

steampunk.description: A soot-choked Victorian metropolis of brass gears, steam-powered airships, clockwork automata, and alchemical mysteries.
